sys_cs_topic.description:
This Topic Block is designed to manage existing badges assigned to users. It supports a range of administrative actions including updating badge details, activating or deactivating badge access, removing badge assignments, and processing badge returns.
Inputs: User ID: The unique identifier of the user whose badge is being managed. Badge Action: The specific action to be performed (e.g., activate, return, remove) (Optional) Badge ID: Identifier of the badge being updated, deactivated, or removed. (Optional) Badge Type: Specifies the type of badge involved in the action. Output: Response String: A structured message confirming the result of the action performed.
